description: Dependency updates for every pinned version in the repository; see docs/guides/github-settings.md.
Weekly, three days after a release, with Conventional Commit messages (build(deps): ...).
Patch, digest, and pin updates merge themselves when the required check passes; people review minor and major updates.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are proposed at once, outside the weekly schedule.

customManagers.description: The lefthook schema that `make check-all` validates lefthook.yml against follows the lefthook version in mise.toml.

packageRules.description: Patch, digest, and pin updates merge themselves once the required check passes.
One pull request a week for the patch updates of each ecosystem.
The textlint packages are released together.
The go directive of every go.mod moves with the Go in mise.toml; Makefile sets GOTOOLCHAIN=local.
pnpm in mise.toml, packageManager in package.json, and pnpm-lock.yaml name the same version.
lefthook in mise.toml and the schema URL in make/repo.mk name the same version.
